[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Merwon Corr''' was a former [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] before defecting to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Lieutenant Corr provided data on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] and its [[Deep Core Security Zone/Legends|security zone]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
